concept.title: Shared drives: questions and answers
concept.shortdesc: Short answers about who owns the files in a shared drive, and how to get one back.

section.title: Who can create a shared drive?
section.p: Anyone in your organization can create one, unless your administrator has turned this off.

section.title: What happens to my files if I leave the team?
section.p: The files stay where they are. A shared drive belongs to the team, not to the person who added the files.

section.title: How do I restore a deleted file?

ol.li: Open the shared drive, and then select Trash.
Select the file, and then select Restore.

section.p: A file stays in the trash for 30 days.
